recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球大小與正常小淋巴球核相近、中央淡染區約佔三分之一，顏色與形狀大致一致，細胞排列稀疏，沒有明顯小球性、低色素或碎片紅血球，符合正色素正球性貧血。
features: Red cells normocytic (similar in size to a small lymphocyte nucleus) with normal central pallor
Normochromic staining with only mild anisocytosis and occasional oval forms
Red cells relatively widely spaced in the monolayer, compatible with reduced red cell mass
No spherocytes, schistocytes, target cells, teardrop cells or polychromasia
Normal segmented neutrophils and scattered normal-sized platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with normal central pallor and only mild anisocytosis, without significant poikilocytosis or polychromasia. Red cells appear somewhat sparse in the monolayer, though red cell density on a smear is an imperfect estimate and the CBC is required to confirm anemia. The neutrophils and platelets are morphologically unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normochromic normocytic anemia; the differential includes anemia of chronic disease or inflammation, renal disease, early iron deficiency, acute blood loss and marrow infiltration or failure, and reticulocyte count and iron studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Progresses to hypochromic microcytic cells with enlarged central pallor, pencil cells and increased RDW, with low ferritin.
Typically shows polychromasia and specific poikilocytes such as spherocytes or schistocytes, which are absent here.
Shows a leukoerythroblastic picture with teardrop cells and circulating nucleated red cells and immature granulocytes, not seen in this field.
